name: Potenza RF
lead: Potenza is a radiofrequency microneedling system from Cynosure, used in aesthetic dermatology for wrinkles, fine lines, scars, stretch marks and pigmentation. Microneedling in general is a cosmetic procedure that punctures the skin with fine needles to induce healing [1].
Information is limited to registered device studies; outcome data are not summarized here.
infobox: Wrinkles, fine lines, crepey skin, acne scars, stretch marks, pigmentation

paras: A completed study that began in 2019 enrolled 79 people to assess an RF microneedling device for wrinkles, fine lines, crepey skin and acne scars [2]. A 2021 feasibility study with 10 participants collected safety and preliminary efficacy data on an RF microneedling device [3]. A 2023 pilot of the Cynosure Potenza system enrolled 20 people with wrinkles, scars, stretch marks and pigmentation [4], and an 8-person 2023 prospective study collected safety data on RF microneedling devices [5]. All are listed as completed; results are not summarized here.

timeline.event: Pilot evaluation of the Cynosure Potenza system begins [4].

quick.overview:
Potenza is a clinic-based RF microneedling system from Cynosure used for wrinkles, scars, stretch marks and pigmentation.

Available documentation is a handful of registered device studies with 8 to 79 participants.
quick.mechanism: Needles enter the skin and deliver radiofrequency energy intended to stimulate remodeling.
quick.risks: Device-specific safety findings are not summarized here. General microneedling infection concerns apply in unregulated settings.
